title: pvTriangleStrips
body:
## pvTriangleStrips

Joins triangles into triangle strips and line segments into polylines (vtkStripper), giving more compact polydata with the same geometry. Other polygons and existing strips or polylines pass through, and cell data is discarded because the cells change. Its main use in workflows is joining separate segments into polylines (JoinContiguousSegments), e.g. contour or slice lines before pvDecimatePolyline, pvPolylineLength or tube.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Cell arrays are lost; convert them to point data first if needed.
- Only triangles are stripped; triangulate general polygons first.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TriangleStrips`. Identity: `filters/Stripper`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Triangle Strips filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `JoinContiguousSegments` | Connect contiguous lines into one polyline. Defaults to off. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MaximumLength` | This property specifies the maximum number of triangles/lines to include in a triangle strip or polyline. | `{"maximum":100000,"minimum":4,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `4` |

```json
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
